{{Color box|{{party color|United Negros Alliance}}|border=darkgray}} [[United Negros Alliance|UNEGA]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Negros Occidental's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Negros Occidental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 20, 2020}} The district consists of the northern Negros Occidental cities of [[Cadiz, Negros Occidental|Cadiz]] and [[Sagay, Negros Occidental|Sagay]], as well as the adjacent municipality of [[Manapla]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Alfredo Marañon III]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP) and [[United Negros Alliance]] (UNEGA).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 20, 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the district consisted of the city of [[Bacolod]] and the northwestern municipalities of [[Bago, Negros Occidental|Bago]], [[La Carlota, Negros Occidental|La Carlota]], [[Murcia, Negros Occidental|Murcia]], [[Pulupandan]], [[San Enrique, Negros Occidental|San Enrique]], [[Talisay, Negros Occidental|Talisay]], and [[Valladolid, Negros Occidental|Valladolid]]. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
